people.gloss: Clear waves (Khuất Nguyên: when the water is clear, wash your hat strings)
people.role: Head of Trạc Anh Đài since 1080; sea hunter of the frost coast; sworn brother of Băng Tâm's Thẩm Hàn Giang
people.appearance: A thick, quiet man with a seal hunter's squint and a white hide coat, who stands in freezing surf as if it were a warm bath.
people.backstory: Đoàn Thanh Lãng was born in Liên Giang Thành during a cold rain that joined the river by night (A139), the son of seal-oil boilers. At sixteen he went through the river ice and Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang), already a Pavilion man, pulled him out; they swore brotherhood on the ice that winter. He walked the coast to Trạc Anh Đài, where the founder Khuất Thanh Anh (khuat_thanh_anh) taught him to dive in winter and throw the iron. In 1080 the white whale the coast calls the Old Ivory tore the Canglang Harpoon out of her back, but the founder's second iron held, and its line took him over the side with the boat going after. Đoàn cut the line (N-trac_anh-02). The boats held their council that winter, Bào Thiết Thủ (bao_thiet_thu) said he had cut it for the crew, and the boats made him head. He is a peaceable man who hunts for a living. He keeps the sect neutral, pays the Pavilion its seal oil, and stays out of its quarrels. In 1170 an old woman of Liên Giang told him who her grandson Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) really was, and made him swear to stand by the boy if the coast ever rose. Now his sworn brother wants the Vessel, and the boy is that brother's disciple; and his harpoon captain wants the whale's calf.
people.wants: To keep the terrace from selling the Old Ivory's calf to Thiên Bảo, and to keep it out of the Pavilion's succession. Under that, to meet the Old Ivory once more in a boat and learn whether he would throw the iron or cut again.
people.secret: He knows Liễu Ngư Ca is Hàn Giang Môn's heir and has sworn to fight for him. Thẩm does not know he knows.

people.role: Elder of the terrace; the last monk of Tê Nhạn Quán and keeper of its palm
people.appearance: A bald, bony monk in a fisher's oilskin, who fingers goose-bone beads while gutting fish.
people.backstory: Raised in Tê Nhạn Quán on the marsh, he came to the terrace at ninety-five with his master Chung Quy Nhạn (chung_quy_nhan), the last abbot, when the abbey's disciples were too few to keep it (V086). The fishers took the monks in, and the monks gave them the Hundred Echo Palm. He is the abbey's last monk, and he sits on the terrace each dawn facing the marsh where the geese still roost in the empty halls.
people.wants: The halls of Tê Nhạn Quán roofed again before he dies, and the geese left in them undisturbed.
people.secret: He feeds the geese in the ruin three sacks of terrace grain a month, entered in the store book as seal feed, and the steward Bào Thiết Thủ has begun to wonder why the seals are so fat.

people.role: The head's daughter; best diver on the terrace, who rows the sixth boat with her divers
people.appearance: Long-armed and sea-browned, with salt-white hair she has had since she was twenty.
people.backstory: Born on the terrace, the daughter of Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang) and a seal-hunter's widow who drowned in 1130. She dives deeper than any man on the coast and has tamed two fur seals that fish for her. She rows the sixth boat with her divers and will not take Ngạc Hải Tiêu's (ngac_hai_tieu) iron, so the hunt cannot lawfully go out. Each dawn she sends her seals over the calf's ground to drive the Old Ivory north. She tells the council the sixth boat's divers are all terrace-born, though she has taken in a Sóc Phương refugee against the old rule.
people.wants: To dive under the ice shelf where no one has gone, and to make the sixth boat the only crew on the coast that is not for sale.
people.secret: She has taken Kim Hải Yến into the dark-of-the-moon dives, against the old rule that the sixth boat's divers be terrace-born, and tells her father the crew is as it was.

people.role: Harpoon captain of the terrace's whaleboats
people.appearance: A big whaler from the Whale Bone Village with a harpoon scar from cheek to collarbone.
people.backstory: He was born in Kình Cốt Thôn the year the Old Ivory took the founder (N-trac_anh-02), and he is the best iron on the coast after Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang). He captains the six whaleboats and wants more for them than seal oil. This winter at Mộc Lan Thành he took the first half of Hồ Tầm Kỳ's (ho_tam_ky) price for the Old Ivory's calf and spent it on new irons, and every crew that takes one is bound to row. Four have. He tells each boat's table that a head who cut the founder's line cannot forbid the hunt.
people.wants: A name on the coast above Đoàn Thanh Lãng's, and the head's seat before the calf is grown.
people.secret: He has promised each captain a new hull from the calf's second half and is counting votes for the next council, where he means to put the head ashore for the cut line of 1080.

people.backstory: He was in the boat in 1080 when Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang) cut the line of the founder's second iron,, and told the council it was for the crew. He captains the fifth and will not fit Ngạc's new iron.

At the ice edge he lets wounded seals die slowly, to teach the boat-boys not to flinch, and he made Ngạc's nephew Quản Tiểu Kình (quan_tieu_kinh) sit beside the last one until it stopped.

people.role: Outer disciple descended from the White Gull hall
people.backstory: Her family fled Bạch Âu Đường when Thôn Hải's pirates burned it (V081); she keeps its gull banner in a chest and wants to raise the hall again. She once stood with the rope coiled while a Thôn Hải-born deckhand went under in the inlet and says the sea took him; his sister rows the fifth boat for Bào Thiết Thủ (bao_thiet_thu) and no longer speaks to her.
people.appearance: A fresh gull feather in her braid each week.

people.cause: dragged under by the white whale Old Ivory off the terrace, at 290
people.backstory: A seal hunter descended from the oil-boilers Băng Tâm moved out of Sóc Phương Thành (V078). In 830 he gathered the coast's hunters on a terrace of clear water and founded Trạc Anh Đài (A137), teaching that a hunter takes what the sea gives, clear or muddy. He took the coast's first whale, made the harpoon line from its sinew, and was taken in 1080 by the Old Ivory, the one whale he never let go of, when his disciple cut the line to save the boat.

ties.note: cut his line in 1080 to save the boat
